Zoe Papadakis  
Email: zoe.papadakis@healthinsight.eu | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/zoe-papadakis | Location: Helsinki, Finland  

At HealthInsight Analytics, I developed predictive models for chronic disease risk using scikit-learn, achieving a 12% improvement in model accuracy for diabetes prediction. My work involved refining feature engineering pipelines, which reduced data preprocessing time by 18% and enhanced model robustness. I also optimized SQL queries for EHR data retrieval, cutting query execution time by 25% and enabling real-time analytics for clinical teams. At MedTech Innovations, I processed over 500,000 patient records using Pandas and SQL, creating visualizations that highlighted trends in treatment efficacy and hospital readmission rates. These insights supported cross-functional teams in refining care protocols.  

Master’s in Data Science, University of Washington (2023). Thesis focused on statistical modeling for predictive healthcare analytics, with a emphasis on integrating clinical and demographic data to improve risk stratification.  

Technical expertise spans Python-based data pipelines, with a focus on NumPy for numerical computations in high-dimensional datasets and Pandas for efficient data cleaning and transformation. My work with scikit-learn has included building ensemble models for patient segmentation and implementing cross-validation strategies that improved model generalization. I routinely use Matplotlib and Plotly for visualizing complex datasets, such as heatmaps of comorbidity patterns and time-series analysis of treatment outcomes. SQL analytics form the backbone of my workflow, with custom scripts that automate data aggregation for quarterly reports. Tableau dashboards I developed for internal stakeholders have been cited for their clarity in tracking key performance indicators across regional health networks.  

Key projects include a feature engineering pipeline for a chronic disease risk model, which incorporated over 200 variables and resulted in a 9% increase in predictive precision. I also led the design of a REST API for internal data sharing, enabling seamless integration between analytics platforms. My exploratory data analysis on EHR datasets uncovered correlations between socioeconomic factors and treatment adherence, prompting a revision in patient outreach strategies.  

Certifications: Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer (2023).  

Languages: English (fluent), Greek (native), Finnish (basic).
